name: Statement
summary: One big line filling the frame, with an optional eyebrow: a hook, a punchline or a turn in the story.
usage: <Statement eyebrow="Agents everywhere" text="Five agents running." accent="One needs you." />

name: Metric
summary: A number that counts up with what it counts under it; real numbers only.
usage: <Metric value={12} label="agents in one window" note="and counting" />

name: Features
summary: Three to six features as cards with icons, coming in one after another: what the product does.
usage: <Features title="Everything in" accent="one window." items={[{icon: Columns3, title: 'Split panes', text: 'Grouped by project'}]} />

props.name: items
props.type: { icon: LucideIcon; title: string; text?: string; }[]

name: Quote
summary: A testimonial with who said it, an initials avatar and their role; real quotes only, with permission.
usage: <Quote quote="I stopped tabbing through terminals." accent="Now they come to me." name="Ada Okafor" role="Design lead" />

name: Compare
summary: Before and after: the old way struck through, the product's way ticked, side by side or stacked.
usage: <Compare title="Stop checking" accent="every tab." before={{title: 'Before', items: ['Tab through every terminal']}} after={{title: 'After', items: ['Every agent in one view']}} />

name: Steps
summary: Numbered steps joined by a line that draws from one to the next: how it works.
usage: <Steps title="How it" accent="works." steps={['Open a group', 'Start your agents', 'Get pinged when one asks']} />

name: LogoReveal
summary: The logo arriving (pop, iris, slide or focus), then the name and a tagline under it.
usage: <LogoReveal kind="pop" tagline="Run agents in parallel." accent="All in one place." />

name: EndCard
summary: The ask, big and held: logo and name, one line, a button with a glint and the URL.
usage: <EndCard line="Your agents keep working." accent="Even when you walk away." button="Download free" url="example.com" />

name: Lineup
summary: People as portrait cards with initials or photos, coming in one after another: speakers, a team, hosts.
usage: <Lineup title="Meet the" accent="speakers." people={[{name: 'Ada Okafor', role: 'Design lead'}, {name: 'Ravi Menon', role: 'Founder'}]} />

props.name: people
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; initials?: string; image?: string; }[]

name: Agenda
summary: A schedule row by row with times, then a highlight slides to the featured row: an event or a launch day.
usage: <Agenda title="Day one" date="Thu · Oct 24" items={[{time: '09:30', title: 'Keynote', who: 'Ravi Menon'}]} highlight={0} />

props.name: items
props.type: { time: string; title: string; who?: string; }[]

name: Countdown
summary: Days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking down for real, each digit rolling: a launch, an event, a sale ending.
usage: <Countdown title="Doors open" accent="soon." to="Oct 24 · 9:00 AM" from={{days: 12, hours: 4, minutes: 32, seconds: 9}} />

props.name: from
props.type: { days: number; hours: number; minutes: number; seconds: number; }

name: Changelog
summary: A version badge, then the changes landing one by one tagged New, Improved or Fixed: release notes.
usage: <Changelog version="v2.4" title="What's" accent="new." items={[{tag: 'New', text: 'Offline mode'}, {tag: 'Fixed', text: 'Sync on flaky connections'}]} />

name: Timeline
summary: Milestones on a line that draws from one to the next, the last one marked: company history or a year in review.
usage: <Timeline title="How we" accent="got here." items={[{when: '2023', what: 'Two people, one idea'}, {when: '2026', what: 'Series A'}]} />

name: List
summary: Labels with dotted leaders to values and an optional detail line: a menu, open roles, prices.
usage: <List title="Today's" accent="menu." items={[{label: 'Flat white', detail: 'Oat or whole', value: '$4.50'}]} />

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; detail?: string; value?: string; }[]

name: Announcement
summary: Big news: the headline lands with a glint and a drawn stroke under it, then a line of detail.
usage: <Announcement eyebrow="Big news" text="We raised $18M" accent="to build what's next." detail="Series A" />

name: Kinetic
summary: A headline that comes in word by word or letter by letter the style's way, with its accent phrase marked as it lands.
usage: <Kinetic text="Approve it" accent="from your phone." start={10} exit={80} />

name: Mark
summary: Draws a highlighter, block, pill, underline, circle, strike or box on any inline words at a given frame.

name: Cycle
summary: One slot in a line whose word changes every few frames, sliding the old word out and the new one in.

name: Counter
summary: A number counting up or down with easing, thousands separators and tabular figures, at a fixed width.

name: Draw
summary: An SVG path that draws itself on, and off again: a hand-drawn underline, a scribble, a route.

name: Arrow
summary: A curved, hand-drawn arrow that draws itself from one point to another, its head landing last.

name: Ring
summary: A ring that fills to a percentage, the number counting up in its middle.

name: Bars
summary: A bar chart whose bars grow in one after another, values counting up, one bar highlighted.

name: LineChart
summary: A line chart that draws across, its area filling in and a dot riding the head with the current value.

name: Stat
summary: A big number counting up, its label under it, with an optional delta chip.

name: Progress
summary: A progress bar filling to a percentage, with its label and percentage above it.

name: Checklist
summary: Items ticking off one by one: each box fills and its check draws in.
usage: <Checklist items={['Tests pass', 'Preview deployed', 'Ready to merge']} start={6} />

name: Burst
summary: Confetti bursting from a point and falling away under gravity: a success moment.

name: Shine
summary: A glint of light sweeping across its children, once or on a loop.

name: Cursor
summary: A macOS pointer gliding through points, with a press and a ripple on clicks.
usage: <Cursor points={[{x: 1300, y: 760, at: 0}, {x: 900, y: 430, at: 30, click: true}]} />

name: Keys
summary: Keyboard keys that pop in and press down one after another: a shortcut.

name: Spotlight
summary: Dims the whole frame except one rectangle, the hole tightening onto it.

props.name: rect
props.type: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; }

name: Toast
summary: A notification sliding in like macOS or iOS: app icon, name, time, title and body.
usage: <Toast title="Build passed" body="All 214 checks green on main" at={8} />

name: Chat
summary: A conversation: bubbles arriving one by one, theirs after typing dots, earlier ones pushed up.
usage: <Chat messages={[{from: 'them', text: 'Can you ship it tonight?', at: 20}, {from: 'me', text: 'Already merged.', at: 46}]} />

name: Badge
summary: A pill label that pops in with an icon or a live dot: New, Beta, Live.

name: Icon
summary: A lucide icon in a tinted tile that pops in, for feature grids.

name: Marquee
summary: A row of words or logos sliding past for ever, its ends fading out.

name: Paper
summary: A card of warm paper with grain, fibres and an uneven edge that slides in and holds a drawing.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | boolean | React.ReactElement<any, string | React.JSXElementConstructo…

name: Flower
summary: A watercolour flower whose stem draws up, leaves unfurl and petals open from a bud.

name: Stamps
summary: A field of stamped motifs landing one after another in speckled ink.

name: HexField
summary: A board of hexagons warming from pale to deep around a hot spot, spreading in a wave.

name: Butterfly
summary: A butterfly that flutters in along a curve and hovers with beating wings.

name: Plant
summary: A plant growing from the bottom of its box: the stem draws up, branches fork, leaves unfurl and tips bloom.

name: Stitch
summary: Embroidery: a sun, circle, heart or leaf filled with satin stitches that appear as if sewn.

name: Watercolor
summary: A watercolour wash painted behind content, as a brushstroke or a spreading pool.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | boolean | React.ReactElement<any, string | React.JSXElementConstructo…

name: Doodles
summary: A hand-drawn mark in a wobbly pen line: underline, circle, arrow, star, heart and more.

name: Constellation
summary: Stars appearing one by one and joining up with fine lines into a constellation.

name: Contours
summary: Topographic contour lines of a made-up landscape, drawing on level by level.

name: Ripple
summary: Drops of ink landing one after another and rippling out in wobbly rings.

name: Scribble
summary: A marker scribbling back and forth to fill a shape behind a word or number.

name: Voiceover
summary: Plays a voiceover's lines one after another, and times scenes to them with voiceTiming and voiceEnd.

name: Captions
summary: Reels-style captions a few words at a time, timed to a voiceover, with the spoken word marked.

props.name: only
props.doc: The indices of the lines this waveform follows; the others leave it flat. Default: all.

props.name: max
props.doc: The most words on screen at once.

props.name: plate
props.doc: A plate behind the words: the default on light styles.

name: Waveform
summary: A waveform that moves with a voice: centred bars, a line, or bars around a ring with a face inside.

props.name: only
props.doc: The indices of the lines this waveform follows; the others leave it flat. Default: all.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | boolean | React.ReactElement<any, string | React.JSXElementConstructo…

name: plain
summary: Just the style's page colour.

name: glow
summary: Soft lights in the accent drifting over faint hairlines.

name: grid
summary: A swiss column grid inside the safe margins, with a + at every other crossing.

name: dots
summary: A dot grid that drifts slowly and fades at the edges.

name: blobs
summary: Pastel cousins of the accent, drifting and changing shape.

name: scanlines
summary: A CRT: scanlines, a rolling band and dark corners.

name: grain
summary: Film grain that dances every frame, with a vignette.

name: aurora
summary: Ribbons of light in the accent swaying over a hairline grid.

name: beams
summary: Light falling from above in slow-swaying beams.

name: spotlight
summary: One soft breathing light from above, the corners in shadow.

name: cut
summary: A hard cut: the next scene replaces this one with no overlap.

name: fade
summary: A cross-fade between the two scenes.

name: dip
summary: The scene fades to the page colour, then the next one fades in from it.

name: slide
summary: The next scene slides in from the right on a spring, pushing this one out.

name: wipe
summary: A hard edge sweeps across from the right, revealing the next scene.

name: iris
summary: A circle opens from the middle onto the next scene.

name: clock
summary: A hand sweeps round like a clock, revealing the next scene.

name: flip
summary: The frame turns over like a card in 3D to show the next scene.

name: zoom
summary: Forward through the cut: this scene rushes past the camera and blurs, the next settles in.

name: whip
summary: A very fast push sideways with a motion smear at its peak.

name: bars
summary: Bars of the accent sweep in, cover the scene, then uncover the next one.

name: flash
summary: A cut hidden in a bright flash, with a little punch-in on the next scene.

name: glitch
summary: A few frames of digital breakup: torn slices and split colour channels.

name: zoomBlur
summary: A radial zoom blur through the cut. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: crossZoom
summary: Both scenes zoom and blur into each other. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: dreamyZoom
summary: A slow, rotating dreamy zoom into the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: filmBurn
summary: A warm film burn flares across the cut. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: crosswarp
summary: The scenes warp sideways into each other. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: ripple
summary: A water ripple spreads from the middle into the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: swap
summary: The two scenes swap places in perspective. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: bookFlip
summary: A page turns like a book onto the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: blurSlide
summary: A slide with a motion blur. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: linearBlur
summary: A directional blur carries one scene into the next. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: pushCut
summary: A push cut with a flash in the accent at the join.
